title: Member Guide to Advances on Operating Lines of Credit — Minimums, Daily Channel Limits and Cutoff Times
content:
Members draw on their Operating Lines of Credit through online banking, the mobile app, by phone with a servicing representative, or at a branch. For each product the association sets a smallest advance, a daily limit for each remote channel, a same-day cutoff time and whether proceeds may go straight to an input supplier.

## Terms

- **Smallest advance**: the smallest advance that will be booked, in USD.
- **Online daily limit**: the total advances that may be booked through online banking and the mobile app on one calendar day, in USD.
- **Phone daily limit**: the total advances that may be booked by phone with a servicing representative on one calendar day, in USD.
- **Same-day cutoff**: the Central-time cutoff (hours and minutes) for an advance requested on a business day to take effect that same day; later requests take effect the next business day.
- **Supplier-direct proceeds**: whether advance proceeds may be paid directly to a seed, fertilizer or chemical supplier on the member's instruction.

## Schedule

| Product | Smallest advance (USD) | Online and mobile daily limit (USD) | Phone daily limit (USD) | Same-day cutoff (Central time) | Proceeds direct to an input supplier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| StartRight Operating Line | 250 | 25000 | 10000 | 14:00 | Allowed |
| ExpressLine Operating Credit | 500 | 50000 | 25000 | 14:00 | Not allowed |
| Seasonal Operating Loan | 1000 | 100000 | 50000 | 14:00 | Allowed |
| Revolving Operating Line | 1000 | 250000 | 100000 | 14:00 | Allowed |
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | 5000 | 500000 | 250000 | 15:00 | Allowed |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | 10000 | 1000000 | 500000 | 15:00 | Not allowed |

The online and mobile limit is one shared limit for both channels together. Branch advances carry no daily channel limit.

## Illustrations (hypothetical requests)

- A Seasonal Operating Loan member who has already drawn USD 30,000 by phone today has USD 20,000 of the USD 50,000 phone limit left for further phone advances that day.
- A Borrowing Base Operating Line request received at 14:45 Central time on a business day is before that product's 15:00 cutoff and takes effect the same day; the same request on a StartRight Operating Line, whose cutoff is 14:00, takes effect the next business day.
